# Little Kit

## Overview

- **Age:** Infant  <sub>[v4 c34 P16](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0016), [v4 c36 P18](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0018), [v4 c40 P16](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c34 P16](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0016), [v4 c34 P24](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0024)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Kit  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004)</sub>; Kit  <sub>[v4 c40 P24](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0024)</sub>; James Obed  <sub>[v4 c34 P24](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Little Kit is an infant who possesses soft fuzz covering his head and has hazel eyes. He features a forehead identical to his father Hugh's and delightful ears that rest directly against his head. He also has chubby little hands and dimples in his elbows.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P16](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0016), [v4 c34 P17](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0017), [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c36 P28](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0028)_

## Personality

Little Kit is a happy and cheerful infant who delights his family with bubbling chuckles. He utters sounds such as 'Wow-ga' to the delight of his mother.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P8](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0008), [v4 c40 P36](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0036)_

## Abilities

- Uttering sounds like 'Wow-ga'  <sub>[v4 c35 P8](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0008)</sub>

## History

Little Kit was born to Nell and Hugh Carrow, receiving the formal name James Obed. His birth brought immense happiness to his parents, and he was showered with affection, hugs, and baby talk by his mother and Lorna. Captain Saul collected a set of unusual items intended as a gift for him. As he grew, he was transitioned into short frocks. When his parents decided to purchase and move to the old Varley place at the Glen, Little Kit departed the home of dreams with Lorna and Tabitha ahead of his parents' final move.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P24](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0024), [v4 c35 P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041), [v4 c36 P37](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0037), [v4 c40 P13](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0013), [v4 c40 P16](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0016), [v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058)_
